messages:
Priya: Hey all — day 2 here. I'm trying to run the staging e2e suite for the onboarding flow but it needs a service account that can write to the Console and toggle feature flags in staging. Should I ask for personal admin or make a service account? What's the recommended path?

Ethan: Prefer a service account for CI/e2e. Personal admin is too broad. Request a short-lived SA scoped to the test project + ff-operator role.

Ravi: +1. For Console write access we map SCIM groups to console roles, so request the 'staging-console-admins-temp' group via the access portal and mention the SA name and TTL you need.

Priya: I tried creating the SA via the infra portal but I got a 403 from the Console API when the tests attempted to toggle flags. Any quick unblock?

Sasha: I can help — I can create a service account for you with a 12h TTL if @Anya approves. In the meantime I'll add you to staging-console-read so you can inspect the flags.

Anya: Approved for a 12h SA for Priya to run onboarding e2e. Sasha, please proceed.

Sasha: Created SA: priya-e2e-1765432100. TTL set to 12h. Token put into secrets manager path: projects/redwood-secrets/staging/priya-e2e. Example to fetch locally: 

```
# fetch token locally
gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=\"priya-e2e-token\" --project=redwood-internal | pbcopy
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=$(pbpaste)
# run tests
./scripts/run_e2e.sh --env staging
```

Sasha: Note: service account creation triggers an audit and security review. Tag your request in the access portal with \"onboard-e2e\" to surface it to the infra reviewers quickly.

oncall-bot: Reminder: creating service accounts and granting Console admin roles triggers an audit log and may require follow-up from security. See https://go/redwood-security/onboarding.

Priya: Thanks!! After using the token my local run could toggle flags and the tests progressed past the flag gating step. Quick question — do I still need the Console admin role, or is the ff-operator role enough for automated flag toggles?

Ethan: For automated toggles in tests, ff-operator is enough. Console admin is only needed for manual UI changes. We prefer SA -> ff-operator + project write scopes for CI. I added ff-operator to priya-e2e SA.

Priya: Verified staging job passed with the new token. Huge help, thanks everyone :party_parrot: 

Ethan: Awesome — closing this thread once you confirm the long-running scheduled staging run finishes. If you need recurring CI creds we can discuss monthly rotation and an automated secret sync. Ping us if you want that set up.
